name: Clarifai
tagline: Computer vision and multimodal AI platform API
description: Clarifai provides a cloud AI platform for image, video, text, and audio models—classification, detection, embeddings, and generative workflows—via a REST API centered on apps, inputs, and model predictions.

auth.details: Personal access token (PAT) or API key via Authorization: Key YOUR_API_KEY header

use_cases: classify objects in an image URL
run a custom Clarifai model prediction
detect faces or concepts in uploaded media
search visual similarity across app inputs
